image_description: A close-up, macro photograph of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) resting on dry brown leaves. The salamander has a glossy black body with distinct, irregular yellow spots and bands. Its head is broad, and the skin appears moist and reflective. The background consists of blurred green foliage and forest floor debris, indicating a shallow depth of field.
